name: list_products
description: List the store catalog with current price, stock, EAN and manufacturer code.

query.description: Text filter on title, SKU or brand

name: get_product
description: Get one product by SKU, with its current price.

name: update_price
description: Set the price customers pay for a product (store currency). Rejected beyond the maximum change configured in the store, or when the store is read-only.

reason.description: Why the price changes (stored in the audit log)

name: revert_price
description: Restore the price a product had before the last update_price.

name: list_price_changes
description: Audit log of price changes made through this MCP, newest first.
